description:
FILED s532b (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-06), the next cause of t/run/locale.t once #4169 let `POSIX->import("locale_h")` succeed (lib/POSIX.pm's import now rewrites the legacy `foo_h` tag spelling to `:foo_h`, as perl's POSIX::import does).

MEASURED (`tools/run-perl-suite.pl --jobs 1 run/locale.t`, scratch/s532b/comp-locale-1.log): `run/locale.t  P: 44/0  C: 0/0  DIFF  aborted-forms:2: Can't locate I18N/Langinfo.pm in @INC (the module is XS and has no PCL build ...)`.  The file's line 25 is `use I18N::Langinfo qw(langinfo RADIXCHAR);`.

What the 44 rows need, read from the file (not yet run -- they sit behind the load):
  1. I18N::Langinfo -- `langinfo(RADIXCHAR)` (and CODESET etc.): nl_langinfo(3).  A shim (lib/I18N/Langinfo.pm) over a blessed `builtin::` primitive, or libc through sb-alien as #3161 does for zlib -- a USER decision for a platform-touching primitive (the portability ruling: install matrix + macOS leg).
  2. find_locales (t/loc_tools.pl) calls setlocale(LC_ALL, NAME) for every locale `locale -a` lists and keeps the ones that SUCCEED; lib/POSIX.pm's setlocale answers $ENV{LC_ALL} || $ENV{LANG} || 'C' whatever it is asked (it never fails and never changes anything), so every name would be "available" and nothing would switch.  The rows test radix characters, `use locale` numeric formatting, fresh_perl children under LC_NUMERIC -- a real setlocale(3) + the numeric formatting honouring it.
Layer: shim + a runtime primitive (rule 9a: the module's facts in lib/, setlocale/nl_langinfo through ONE blessed seam).  Size: a session; not one mechanism.  Companion rows: run/locale.t's *summary* row (baselines/perl-suite-fails.tsv) and its row-shortfall 44, re-caused #4169 -> here by s532b.
subject: t/run/locale.t stops at `use I18N::Langinfo qw(langinfo RADIXCHAR)` (an XS module with no PCL build or shim) -- 44 perl rows never produced; behind it the file needs a REAL setlocale (lib/POSIX.pm's answers the environment's locale and changes nothing)
